summary.summary:
Migrated pydantic_sqlite from pydantic 1 to pydantic 2 API (pydantic 2.14.4 in the sandbox); all 30 tests pass.

Code changes (pydantic_sqlite/_core.py):
- Replaced `ModelField` import with `FieldInfo`; `_typing_conversion` takes a `FieldInfo` and reads `.annotation`.
- `@root_validator(pre=True)` on TableBaseModel -> `@model_validator(mode='before')` + `@classmethod`.
- `value.dict()` -> `value.model_dump()`; `value.__fields__` -> `type(value).model_fields`.
- v1 `field.type_` (inner type with Optional/List unwrapped) replaced by new helpers `_strip_optional` / `_inner_type` that compute the same thing from `field.annotation`.
- Read path: removed the `inspect.getmembers` + `str(ModelField)` string parsing; it now uses `model_fields[...].annotation` to decide whether a column holds JSON (List or Union).
- Union fields are now stored as JSON (`json.dumps`) instead of `str(value)`, and decoded with `json.loads` on read. Needed because pydantic 2 keeps `int` in `Union[str, int]` (v1 silently coerced ints to str), so the type must survive the round trip.
- Removed `iterable_in_type_repr` from _misc.py (its only use was the string-based check) and the unused `inspect` import.

Packaging: pyproject.toml pin changed from `pydantic = "^1.8.2"` to `pydantic = "^2.0"`. No companion packages depend on pydantic in this repo.

Items for review (not verified by tests):
- poetry.lock still pins pydantic 1.x; it needs regenerating with `poetry lock`.
- Existing .db files saved by v1 with Union-typed columns hold plain text (e.g. `hello`), which `json.loads` will fail on when loaded. A fallback or a migration step may be wanted.
- Dict[...] fields: v1 used the value type and stored raw; the v2 path now raises NotImplementedError in _typing_conversion. No test covers this.
- Literal fields are still stored with str(), so Literal[1, 2] (non-string literals) would not round-trip. Same as before, but worth noting.
